title: C24/80/2019 of KAJAL NAUTIYAL Vs VINOD NAUTIYAL

paras.text:
C24 No.80 of 2019
Honíble Lok Pal Singh, J.

Mr. V.P. Bahuguna, Advocate for the
applicant.
This Court, vide order dated 12.02.2020,
had permitted the applicant to serve the
respondent by way of dasti notice. Pursuant to
such order, the applicant has filed the
compliance affidavit by way of misc.
application IA No.5865 of 2020 to indicate that
the dasti notice has been served to the
respondent personally. Affidavit is taken on
record. Application made therefor stands
disposed.
Despite service of notice, none is present
for the respondent.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant.
By means of present transfer application,
applicant seeks to transfer the proceedings of
O.S. No.503 of 2019 Vinod Nautiyal vs. Smt.
Kajal Nautiyal under Section 9 of Hindi
Marriage Act, pending before the Family Court
Haridwar to the Family Court, Dehradun.
Ground shown for transfer of
proceedings by the applicant is that since the
day she was ousted by the respondent from
her matrimonial house, she is living with her
child at her parental house at Dehradun. She
has no source of income and is dependent on
her family. That apart, she has an ailing child
and it is not possible for her to leave her ailing
child alone at Dehradun for attending the
court proceedings at Haridwar.
Considering the facts and circumstances
that have been brought on record, instant
transfer application is allowed. O.S. No.503 of
2019 Vinod Nautiyal vs. Smt. Kajal Nautiyal,
under Section 9 of Hindi Marriage Act,
pending before the Family Court Haridwar is
transferred to the Family Court, Dehradun.
